parameters.name: Operation_Mode
choices: Interpolate & Map Existing Data (Offline Mode - No Internet)
parameters.description:
REQUIRED. Choose operation mode:
'Download & Generate Atlas (Full Pipeline)': Online mode. Queries climate data for input points, computes indicators, builds feature classes, and interpolates rasters.
'Interpolate & Map Existing Data (Offline Mode)': Offline mode. No internet queries. Takes a precalculated point layer already containing climate fields and directly performs spatial interpolation, masking, and atlas map generation.

parameters.name: Execution_Workflow_Mode
parameters.default: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
choices: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
parameters.description:
DOWNLOAD MODE ONLY. Choose workflow execution architecture:
'Batch Mode: Download All Then Process' (recommended): Queries and saves data for all requested climate modules and submodels into the Geodatabase first, ensuring total data safety against network interruptions, then interpolates all surfaces in a second pass.
'Sequential Mode: Element by Element': Queries, computes, and interpolates surfaces for each climate module one by one, providing immediate visual progress in the map layout.

parameters.name: Download_Only
parameters.en: Download & Save Point Data Only (Skip Rasters & Atlas)
parameters.ar: تنزيل وحفظ بيانات النقاط فقط (تخطي الراسترات والأطلس)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, the tool downloads climate data and saves complete point feature classes and Excel tables for each element, but skips surface interpolation, raster creation, contours, and layer styling.

parameters.name: Input_Point_Features
parameters.ar: طبقة نقاط الإدخال (شيب فايل أو فيتشر كلاس)
parameters.description: REQUIRED for Download mode. Point layer (shapefile or geodatabase feature class). Each point is queried against the data source using its WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) longitude/latitude.

parameters.name: Precalculated_Point_Layers
parameters.description: REQUIRED for Offline mode. One or more existing point layers (from GDB or Shapefile) containing pre-calculated climate attributes. The tool automatically merges them by coordinates/Source_ID.

parameters.name: Study_Area_Mask
parameters.description: OPTIONAL but recommended. Polygon used to set processing extent/mask, clip final rasters, and generate wind vectors/isobars.

parameters.name: Study_Area_Name
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Name of the study area (e.g. 'Egypt', 'Sinai', 'Aswan', 'Nile Basin'). Used to title the atlas, name the boundary layer archived in GDB, and generate the Classification Workbook.

parameters.name: Output_Workspace
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Output folder workspace. A File Geodatabase 'Climate_Database.gdb' is created inside automatically. Per-element point layers (Temperature, Precipitation, etc.) are stored in the GDB. Existing outputs are overwritten.

parameters.name: Output_Spatial_Reference
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Target coordinate system for all outputs. DEFAULT: same as input points.

parameters.name: Measurement_Units_System
parameters.ar: نظام وحدات القياس (متري Metric / إمبراطوري Imperial)
choices: Imperial (Fahrenheit °F, Inches in, inHg, mph, MJ/m2/day)
parameters.description:
Select the measurement units system for atlas outputs.
• Metric (Default): Celsius (°C), Millimeters (mm), Hectopascals (hPa), Meters/second (m/s), kWh/m2/day conforming to WMO and Egyptian standards.
• Imperial: Fahrenheit (°F), Inches (in), Inches of Mercury (inHg), Miles/hour (mph), MJ/m2/day.
• Custom Units: Manually customize units for each climate variable below.

parameters.name: Temperature_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for temperature variables: Celsius (°C, default), Fahrenheit (°F), or Kelvin (K).

parameters.name: Precipitation_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for precipitation and rainfall: Millimeters (mm, default) or Inches (in).

parameters.name: Pressure_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for atmospheric and sea level pressure: Hectopascals (hPa, default), Millibars (mbar), Inches of Mercury (inHg), or Kilopascals (kPa).

parameters.name: Wind_Speed_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for surface wind speed: Meters/second (m/s, default), km/h, kt, or mph.

parameters.name: Solar_Radiation_Unit
parameters.default: Kilowatt-hours per square meter per day (kWh/m2/day) [Default]
choices: Kilowatt-hours per square meter per day (kWh/m2/day) [Default]
Megajoules per square meter per day (MJ/m2/day)
Watt-hours per square meter per day (Wh/m2/day)
Calories per square centimeter per day (cal/cm2/day, Langley)
parameters.description: Measurement unit for surface solar radiation: Kilowatt-hours/m2/day (kWh/m2/day, default in Egypt & WMO), Megajoules/m2/day (MJ/m2/day), Watt-hours/m2/day (Wh/m2/day), or Calories/cm2/day (cal/cm2/day, Langley).

parameters.name: Export_Shapefiles
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, exports per-element shapefiles to the Export_SHP folder and wind vector shapefiles. When unchecked, only the File Geodatabase, rasters and tables are produced.

parameters.name: Create_Arabic_Database
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). Creates a second GDB copy (<name>_AR.gdb) with Arabic field aliases only - field names stay English so the copy remains reusable as offline input. For Arabic users to read and understand the columns.

parameters.name: Climate_Data_Source
parameters.default: Hybrid: NOAA Station Observations + NASA / ERA5 Gap-Filling
choices: Hybrid: NOAA Station Observations + NASA / ERA5 Gap-Filling
parameters.description:
REQUIRED. Data provider for all climate queries.
• 'Hybrid: NOAA Station Observations + NASA / ERA5 Gap-Filling' [Recommended]: Ground-truth station harmonization with ERA5 reanalysis and satellite solar/UV gap-filling.
• 'NASA POWER API': Gridded global agroclimatology & solar radiation (1981-Present).
• 'Open-Meteo Historical API (ERA5 Reanalysis)': High-resolution numerical atmospheric reanalysis (~9 km, 1940-Present).
• Precalculated data from any source can also be used in Offline mode.

parameters.name: OpenMeteo_Model
parameters.ar: النموذج المناخي للشبكة الأوروبية (Open-Meteo ERA5 Reanalysis)
parameters.default: Auto: Finest suitable model per variable [Default]
choices: Auto: Finest suitable model per variable [Default]
parameters.description: SOURCE RESOLUTION. Highest available ERA5 grid is the default: ERA5-Land 0.1 deg (~11 km API grid), starting 1950. ERA5 is 0.25 deg, starting 1940. Seamless mixes grids by variable. NOAA is station-only; POWER grids are fixed by variable. Smaller output cells do not increase source information resolution.

parameters.name: CDS_API_Key
parameters.en: Copernicus CDS API Key / Personal Token
parameters.ar: Copernicus CDS API Key / Personal Token
parameters.description: Need Sign In: your own CDS personal token. Accept the dataset terms on CDS. Never include the token in shared projects or logs. Public sources do not require it.

parameters.name: Time_Mode
parameters.description: REQUIRED. 'Single Year' queries January-December of one year. 'Year Range' computes multi-year climatological normals. 'Custom Date Range' queries specific start/end dates via calendar or text.

parameters.name: Single_Year
parameters.description: Type any year you need (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: Start_Year
parameters.description: Type the first year of the period (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: End_Year
parameters.description: Type the last year of the period (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: Start_Date
parameters.description: CUSTOM DATE RANGE ONLY. Pick from the built-in calendar (any past or future year) or type the date directly.

parameters.name: End_Date
parameters.description: CUSTOM DATE RANGE ONLY. Pick from the built-in calendar (any past or future year) or type the date directly.

parameters.name: Temporal_Resolution
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Monthly (recommended): faster, uses monthly means/rates. Daily: detailed, required for max daily rainfall / extremes.

parameters.name: Gap_Fill_Method
parameters.ar: طريقة استكمال ومعالجة القيم المفقودة (Gap Filling)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. How to handle missing months or stations (NoData/-999). 'Climatological Month Mean' (recommended): fills gaps with the average of the same calendar month across years, with station mean fallback. 'Linear + Boundary Interpolation': fills interior gaps linearly and endpoints using boundary fill. 'Spatial Nearest Neighbor Fallback': estimates missing fields from nearest valid spatial stations. 'No Fill': ignores missing values.

parameters.name: Point_Tolerance
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default 0 = OFF). Merges points closer than this distance before download to reduce interpolation artifacts.

parameters.name: Climate_Modules
choices: Heat Index / Thermal Stress [Requires: Temperature, Relative Humidity]
Wind Chill / Cold Stress [Requires: Temperature, Wind]
De Martonne Aridity Index [Requires: Temperature, Precipitation]
Walter-Lieth Dry Months Count [Requires: Temperature, Precipitation]
parameters.description: Select primary climate modules and applied bioclimatic models to compute and export. Submodels (De Martonne, Evapotranspiration, UNEP, Water Deficit, Walter-Lieth, Heat Index) are located at the bottom of the list and can be selected directly; prerequisite variables are retrieved automatically if not selected.

parameters.name: Temporal_Scope
parameters.description: TEMPORAL MATRIX SCOPE. Select which temporal scopes and seasons to compute and map (Annual, Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). Uncheck any seasons not needed (e.g. keep only Annual for fast regional atlas, or Summer only for heat waves). The tool computes only the Cartesian product of selected Climate Modules and selected Temporal Scope.

parameters.name: Generate_Monthly_Rasters
parameters.description: GENERATE 12 INDIVIDUAL MONTHLY RASTERS (Jan-Dec). When checked, interpolates independent climatological surface rasters for all 12 calendar months into a dedicated 'Month' subfolder for each selected element (same interpolation method, cell size and clip mask; LZW, 128x128 blocks). Requires a multi-year period (>= 2 years); single years are skipped with a warning. Wind produces 24 surfaces (12 speed W_Spd_* + 12 direction W_Dir_*).

parameters.name: Save_Daily_Series
parameters.ar: حفظ السلاسل الزمنية اليومية (شيتات Excel + قاعدة البيانات)
parameters.description: SAVE DAILY TIME SERIES INSIDE EACH ELEMENT WORKBOOK. When checked (and Temporal is Daily), adds a third 'Daily' sheet (OBJECTID, Source_ID, Date, daily values) to each element .xls; the Month sheet is always kept (computed from daily). Opt-in because daily volumes grow fast (points x days); recommended for short periods / few points. Monthly (default) ignores it. Large daily series are split across Daily, Daily_2, etc., without dropping rows. CSV is used only if Excel export fails.

parameters.name: Extended_WC_Seasons
parameters.en: Wind Chill Full Suite for Cold Regions (Seasons+Ranges+Monthly)
parameters.ar: Wind Chill Full Suite for Cold Regions (Seasons+Ranges+Monthly)
parameters.description: OPT-IN FOR COLD REGIONS ONLY (e.g. Patagonia, Iceland, high mountains, Canada): publishes WC_Spring/Summer/Autumn_Mean, WC_Annual_Range and the 12 monthly WC means in addition to WC_Winter_Mean and WC_Annual_Mean. OFF by default: warm regions (e.g. Egypt) keep the clean 2-field schema, where extra fields would merely repeat air temperature (passthrough). Same NWS equation/threshold.

parameters.name: Monthly_Ranges
parameters.en: Monthly Ranges - Interannual Variability per Month
parameters.ar: Monthly Ranges - Interannual Variability per Month
parameters.description: OPT-IN, independent toggle (default OFF): adds per-calendar-month interannual ranges (<Prefix>_<Month>_Range, e.g. ET_December_Range = wettest December minus driest December across years) for the mean-type modules (T, R, PSL, PS, Wind speed, RH, Td, Solar, UV, Cloud, ET). Wind direction excluded. Month sheet and Month/ rasters carry them like the monthly means. Needs >= 2 valid years per month; gap-filled months yield 0.

parameters.name: Extended_HI_Months
parameters.description: OPT-IN, independent toggle (default OFF): publishes the 12 monthly Rothfusz heat-index means (HI_January_Mean ... HI_December_Mean) in addition to the 8 base Heat Index fields. Documented winter caveat: monthly values use Rothfusz year-round (= air T below 26.7C), while the seasonal HI_Winter_Mean uses Humidex. Month sheet and Month/ rasters carry them like the other monthly means.

parameters.name: Field_Filter_Scope
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Controls which variables, seasons, and indicators are computed and exported. 'Full Suite (Annual + Seasonal + Monthly)' (default): calculates and maps all annual, seasonal, monthly and extreme fields. 'Annual Summaries Only': restricts processing strictly to annual summaries, means and totals. 'Seasonal Summaries Only': restricts processing strictly to seasonal summaries (Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). 'Monthly Climatology Only (Jan - Dec)': restricts processing strictly to the 12 individual calendar months (Jan-Dec). 'Filter by Specific Seasons & Aggregations': quickly filter by specific season or summary level. 'Custom Field Checklist': interactive checklist table at the end of this group to select/unselect exact fields by name.

parameters.name: Included_Aggregations
parameters.description: PERIOD FILTER ONLY. Choose summary levels to generate. 'Annual Summaries': annual means and totals. 'Seasonal Summaries': seasonal means and totals (Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). 'Detailed Monthly Climatology': 12 individual monthly climatologies (Jan-Dec). 'Extreme & Bioclimatic Indices': heat index, ranges, extreme months, rain days.

parameters.name: Included_Seasons
parameters.description: SEASONS FILTER ONLY. Select which seasons to generate. Uncheck any season you do not need (e.g. keep only Summer or only Winter).

parameters.name: Selected_Fields
parameters.description: VARIABLES SELECTION. Interactive checklist of climate variables and indicators to compute. All fields for the selected Climate Modules are included by default. Check or uncheck individual variables as needed, or use the Filter Scope above to filter by seasons/periods.

parameters.name: Interpolation_Method
parameters.description: REQUIRED. IDW (default) | Ordinary Kriging | Spline | Natural Neighbor. Requires Spatial Analyst.

parameters.name: Base_Cell_Size
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Cell size for all rasters in Meters or Kilometers. Default: 500 Meters. NOTE: fine cells improve appearance only; native NASA POWER resolution stays coarse (~0.5 deg).

parameters.name: Wind_Factor_Cell_Size
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Independent coarser spacing for wind arrow points in Meters or Kilometers. Default: 25000 Meters. Enabled only when Wind module is selected.

parameters.name: IDW_Curve_Profile
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Distance decay curve profile. 'Gentle / Smooth' (power 1.2) eliminates concentric island/bullseye artifacts. 'Standard' (power 2.0) is the classical steep quadratic decay. 'Regional Broad' (power 0.7) gives extended regional smoothing. 'Custom Power' allows typing an arbitrary power.

parameters.name: IDW_Power
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Power parameter. DEFAULT 1.2 for smooth, seamless climate surfaces without artificial bullseyes.

parameters.name: IDW_Search_Type
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. 'Variable' (default): expand search. 'Fixed': fixed radius.

parameters.name: IDW_Num_Points
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Number of neighbouring points. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: IDW_Max_Distance
parameters.description: IDW ONLY, OPTIONAL. Caps the search neighbourhood in metres.

parameters.name: Krig_Model
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. DEFAULT Spherical.

parameters.name: Krig_Type
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. 'Ordinary' (default) or 'Universal'.

parameters.name: Krig_Num_Points
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: Spline_Type
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. 'Tension' (recommended for climate): produces taut, smooth surfaces that honor exact point values without overshoots. 'Regularized': smooth surface that may overshoot local extremes.

parameters.name: Spline_Weight
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. Weight parameter. For Tension Spline, higher weights (e.g. 5.0-10.0) produce stiffer, less smoothed surfaces closely matching points; smaller weights produce smoother surfaces. DEFAULT 5.0.

parameters.name: Spline_Num_Points
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. Number of neighbouring points used for interpolation. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: Enable_Raster_Reclass
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, generates classified rasters (_cls.tif) with discrete thematic classes and embedded colormaps alongside the continuous rasters. When unchecked, outputs only raw continuous floating-point rasters.

parameters.name: Reclass_Classes_Count
parameters.description: RECLASS ONLY. Number of classification bins/classes (2 to 32). Default: 7.

parameters.name: Reclass_Method
parameters.description: RECLASS ONLY. Statistical classification method to partition raster continuous values.

parameters.name: Create_Isobars
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Creates isobar polylines from pressure rasters when a pressure module is selected.

parameters.name: Pressure_Interval_Scheme
parameters.description: ISOBARS ONLY. Contour interval preset.

parameters.name: Custom_Pressure_Step
parameters.description: ISOBARS ONLY, CUSTOM SCHEME ONLY. Step in mbar/hPa. Must be > 0.

parameters.name: Focal_Smoothing
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Smooths interpolated rasters with Focal Statistics.

parameters.name: Focal_Statistic
parameters.description: FOCAL ONLY. DEFAULT MEAN.

parameters.name: Focal_Neighborhood
parameters.description: FOCAL ONLY. Square neighbourhood in cells (3 = 3x3). DEFAULT 3.

parameters.name: Add_To_Map
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). Safely adds final layers to the current map sequentially.

parameters.name: Map_Add_Modules
parameters.description: ADD-TO-MAP ONLY. Choose which elements to add to the map.

parameters.name: Purge_Cache
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default ON). Deletes intermediate products after use.

parameters.name: Export_Separate_Years
parameters.en: Export Separate Excel Workbook per Year (also keep combined workbook)
parameters.ar: Export Separate Excel Workbook per Year (also keep combined workbook)
parameters.description: For multi-year downloads, also export <Element>/Years/<Element>_<Year>.xls. Recomputes each year's Data and Month summaries from that year's data using the same units and gap filling; includes Source_Data and Daily sheets when daily saving is enabled. Reuses downloaded data. Does not create separate yearly rasters or GIS databases.

parameters.name: Source_Username
parameters.en: NASA Earthdata username / اسم المستخدم — Need Sign In
parameters.ar: NASA Earthdata username / اسم المستخدم — Need Sign In
parameters.description: Use your own NASA Earthdata account. Authorize GES DISC if required. Credentials are not included in MIRSAD output logs.

parameters.name: Source_Password
parameters.en: NASA Earthdata password / كلمة المرور — Need Sign In
parameters.ar: NASA Earthdata password / كلمة المرور — Need Sign In
parameters.description: Use your own NASA Earthdata account. Authorize GES DISC if required. Credentials are not included in MIRSAD output logs.

parameters.name: Supplementary_RHmax
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: percent. max(hourly RH). Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_RHmin
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: percent. min(hourly RH). Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_ea
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: kPa. FAO56 eq14 dewpoint; otherwise eq17 RH extrema. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_es
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: kPa. [e(Tmax)+e(Tmin)]/2; FAO56 eq11-12. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_VPD_Source
parameters.en: Source daily maximum vapour pressure deficit (VPD_Source)
parameters.ar: أقصى عجز يومي لضغط البخار من المصدر (VPD_Source)
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: kPa; daily maximum. max(hourly source VPD); distinct from FAO56 daily deficit. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_VPD_FAO56
parameters.ar: عجز ضغط البخار اليومي وفق FAO56 (VPD_FAO56)
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: kPa. es-ea. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Trange
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: deg_C difference. Tmax-Tmin. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Sunshine_Hours
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: hours/day. source sunshine seconds / 3600. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Ra
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: MJ/m2/day. FAO56 eq21-26; latitude and day of year. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_U2
parameters.ar: سرعة الرياح المعدلة إلى ارتفاع مترين (U2)
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: m/s at 2m. FAO56 eq47; confirmed measurement height required. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Rn_FAO56
parameters.ar: صافي الإشعاع لمرجع عشبي وفق FAO56 (Rn_FAO56)
parameters.description: Optional output within its selected parent module; requires Daily processing. Unit: MJ/m2/day. FAO56 eq37-40; albedo 0.23; known elevation required. Supplementary units are canonical as stated; existing fields and raw values are preserved. Hourly_Processing records UTC sample counts; incomplete inputs remain NULL. Rn requires a known metre elevation attribute; no sea-level default.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Rasters
parameters.description: Optional supplementary mean/range surfaces; coverage counts are never interpolated.

parameters.name: Evapotranspiration_Methods
parameters.description: HG is the preserved default. PM is an independent daily FAO56 product; known metre elevation and complete inputs required. PM never replaces HG in UNEP/water-deficit indices.

parameters.name: Evapotranspiration_Raster_Methods
parameters.description: Independent raster selection. Only calculated methods may be interpolated; PM raster is off by default.

tools.en: MIRSAD: Ground Weather Stations Climate Atlas Generator
tools.ar: MIRSAD: Ground Weather Stations Climate Atlas Generator (AR)

parameters.name: Station_Selection_Mode
choices: Spatial Intersect by Study Area Boundary (Polygon Clip)
Custom Station IDs (Manual Entry / From Explorer)
Global Network (Worldwide - Caution: High Station Count)
Select Specific Stations by Country (Multiple Selection)
parameters.description:
Choose how weather stations are chosen:
• 'Select by Country (National Network)': filters certified NOAA/WMO stations by country or region.
• 'Spatial Intersect by Study Area Boundary': clips stations falling within your polygon boundary (+ optional buffer).
• 'Custom Station IDs': specify USAF/WMO station IDs directly.
• 'Global Network': process all global stations worldwide.
• 'Local Saved Station Layer': load a pre-saved station feature layer from disk.
• 'Select Specific Stations by Country': choose a country, then one or more named stations.

parameters.name: Region_Filter
parameters.description: First-tier spatial filter to narrow down country list.

parameters.name: Select_Country
parameters.description: Second-tier national network filter or aggregate scope (e.g. All Arab League, All Asian).

parameters.name: Selected_Stations
parameters.description: Choose a region and country, then optionally select stations in national network mode. Leave empty to process the full national network. In 'Select Specific Stations by Country' mode, at least one station is required. Labels show station name, USAF/WBAN codes and country.

parameters.name: Study_Area_Polygon
parameters.en: Study Area Boundary Polygon (Optional Mask / Clip)
parameters.ar: مضلع حدود منطقة الدراسة (قناع / استقطاع اختياري)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL polygon feature layer. Used to spatially clip weather stations, define the processing extent/mask, and clip output rasters.

parameters.name: Supplementary_Points
parameters.en: Supplementary Survey Points (Optional - To Densify Data-Sparse Areas)
parameters.ar: نقاط رفع إضافية داعمة (اختيارية - لتكثيف المناطق الفارغة)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL point feature layer (shapefile or geodatabase feature class). Custom sampling points (e.g., in unmonitored desert regions or project sites) will be automatically merged with the selected certified weather stations to enhance spatial interpolation coverage.

parameters.name: Include_Buffer_Stations
parameters.en: Include Neighboring Buffer Stations (30 km Halo for Interpolation)
parameters.ar: تضمين محطات النطاق العازل المجاورة (حرم 30 كم لدقة الاستيفاء)
parameters.description: When polygon clipping is active, includes stations within a 30 km halo outside the boundary to prevent edge degradation and distortion during spatial interpolation.

parameters.name: Custom_Station_IDs
parameters.ar: أكواد المحطات المخصصة (أكواد USAF مفصولة بفاصلة منقوطة)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Enter semicolon-separated USAF station codes (e.g. 623660;624140;623180).

parameters.name: Local_Station_Features
parameters.ar: طبقة محطات محلية محفوظة (شيب فايل أو فيتشر كلاس)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Load a pre-existing weather stations shapefile or GDB feature class.

parameters.name: Operation_Mode
choices: Interpolate & Map Existing Data (Offline Mode - No Internet)
parameters.description:
REQUIRED. Choose operation mode:
'Download & Generate Atlas (Full Pipeline)': Online mode. Queries climate data for input points, computes indicators, builds feature classes, and interpolates rasters.
'Interpolate & Map Existing Data (Offline Mode)': Offline mode. No internet queries. Takes a precalculated point layer already containing climate fields and directly performs spatial interpolation, masking, and atlas map generation.

parameters.name: Execution_Workflow_Mode
parameters.default: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
choices: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
parameters.description:
DOWNLOAD MODE ONLY. Choose workflow execution architecture:
'Batch Mode: Download All Then Process' (recommended): Queries and saves data for all requested climate modules and submodels into the Geodatabase first, ensuring total data safety against network interruptions, then interpolates all surfaces in a second pass.
'Sequential Mode: Element by Element': Queries, computes, and interpolates surfaces for each climate module one by one, providing immediate visual progress in the map layout.

parameters.name: Download_Only
parameters.en: Download & Save Point Data Only (Skip Rasters & Atlas)
parameters.ar: تنزيل وحفظ بيانات النقاط فقط (تخطي الراسترات والأطلس)
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, the tool downloads climate data and saves complete point feature classes and Excel tables for each element, but skips surface interpolation, raster creation, contours, and layer styling.

parameters.name: Precalculated_Point_Layers
parameters.description: REQUIRED for Offline mode. One or more existing point layers (from GDB or Shapefile) containing pre-calculated climate attributes. The tool automatically merges them by coordinates/Source_ID.

parameters.name: Study_Area_Name
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Name of the study area (e.g. 'Egypt', 'Sinai', 'Aswan', 'Nile Basin'). Used to title the atlas, name the boundary layer archived in GDB, and generate the Classification Workbook.

parameters.name: Output_Workspace
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Output folder workspace. A File Geodatabase 'Climate_Database.gdb' is created inside automatically. Per-element point layers (Temperature, Precipitation, etc.) are stored in the GDB. Existing outputs are overwritten.

parameters.name: Output_Spatial_Reference
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Target coordinate system for all outputs. DEFAULT: same as input points.

parameters.name: Measurement_Units_System
parameters.ar: نظام وحدات القياس (متري Metric / إمبراطوري Imperial)
choices: Imperial (Fahrenheit °F, Inches in, inHg, mph, MJ/m2/day)
parameters.description:
Select the measurement units system for atlas outputs.
• Metric (Default): Celsius (°C), Millimeters (mm), Hectopascals (hPa), Meters/second (m/s), kWh/m2/day conforming to WMO and Egyptian standards.
• Imperial: Fahrenheit (°F), Inches (in), Inches of Mercury (inHg), Miles/hour (mph), MJ/m2/day.
• Custom Units: Manually customize units for each climate variable below.

parameters.name: Temperature_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for temperature variables: Celsius (°C, default), Fahrenheit (°F), or Kelvin (K).

parameters.name: Precipitation_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for precipitation and rainfall: Millimeters (mm, default) or Inches (in).

parameters.name: Pressure_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for atmospheric and sea level pressure: Hectopascals (hPa, default), Millibars (mbar), Inches of Mercury (inHg), or Kilopascals (kPa).

parameters.name: Wind_Speed_Unit
parameters.description: Measurement unit for surface wind speed: Meters/second (m/s, default), km/h, kt, or mph.

parameters.name: Solar_Radiation_Unit
parameters.default: Kilowatt-hours per square meter per day (kWh/m2/day) [Default]
choices: Kilowatt-hours per square meter per day (kWh/m2/day) [Default]
Megajoules per square meter per day (MJ/m2/day)
Watt-hours per square meter per day (Wh/m2/day)
Calories per square centimeter per day (cal/cm2/day, Langley)
parameters.description: Measurement unit for surface solar radiation: Kilowatt-hours/m2/day (kWh/m2/day, default in Egypt & WMO), Megajoules/m2/day (MJ/m2/day), Watt-hours/m2/day (Wh/m2/day), or Calories/cm2/day (cal/cm2/day, Langley).

parameters.name: Export_Shapefiles
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, exports per-element shapefiles to the Export_SHP folder and wind vector shapefiles. When unchecked, only the File Geodatabase, rasters and tables are produced.

parameters.name: Create_Arabic_Database
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). Creates a second GDB copy (<name>_AR.gdb) with Arabic field aliases only - field names stay English so the copy remains reusable as offline input. For Arabic users to read and understand the columns.

parameters.name: Climate_Data_Source
parameters.default: Hybrid: NOAA Station Observations + NASA / ERA5 Gap-Filling
choices: Hybrid: NOAA Station Observations + NASA / ERA5 Gap-Filling
parameters.description:
Select meteorological data provider for the weather stations:
Hybrid downloads NOAA GSOD for the whole network, then selected ERA5, then NASA POWER for missing values.
NOAA GSOD Only requires an exact USAF/WBAN/location identity; no nearest-station substitution. Archive starts 1929, station coverage varies.
ERA5 Standalone uses only the selected model: ERA5-Land 0.1 degree/from 1950; ERA5 0.25 degree/from 1940; Seamless varies by variable. Land lacks rain/wind in this API.
Any-point Hybrid uses ERA5 then NASA. Legacy Open-Meteo retains its NASA supplement. NASA has fixed native meteorology and solar grids.
Missing/unsupported variables remain NULL; selected monthly estimates are recorded separately. Resolution is source information, not output raster pixels.

parameters.name: OpenMeteo_Model
parameters.default: Auto: Finest suitable model per variable [Default]
choices: Auto: Finest suitable model per variable [Default]
parameters.description: SOURCE RESOLUTION. Highest available ERA5 grid is the default: ERA5-Land 0.1 deg (~11 km API grid), starting 1950. ERA5 is 0.25 deg, starting 1940. Seamless mixes grids by variable. NOAA is station-only; POWER grids are fixed by variable. Smaller output cells do not increase source information resolution.

parameters.name: CDS_API_Key
parameters.en: Copernicus CDS API Key / Personal Token
parameters.ar: Copernicus CDS API Key / Personal Token
parameters.description: Need Sign In: your own CDS personal token. Accept the dataset terms on CDS. Never include the token in shared projects or logs. Public sources do not require it.

parameters.name: Time_Mode
parameters.description: REQUIRED. 'Single Year' queries January-December of one year. 'Year Range' computes multi-year climatological normals. 'Custom Date Range' queries specific start/end dates via calendar or text.

parameters.name: Single_Year
parameters.description: Type any year you need (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: Start_Year
parameters.description: Type the first year of the period (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: End_Year
parameters.description: Type the last year of the period (free entry, no list).

parameters.name: Start_Date
parameters.description: CUSTOM DATE RANGE ONLY. Pick from the built-in calendar (any past or future year) or type the date directly.

parameters.name: End_Date
parameters.description: CUSTOM DATE RANGE ONLY. Pick from the built-in calendar (any past or future year) or type the date directly.

parameters.name: Temporal_Resolution
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Monthly (recommended): faster, uses monthly means/rates. Daily: detailed, required for max daily rainfall / extremes.

parameters.name: Gap_Fill_Method
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. How to handle missing months or stations (NoData/-999). 'Climatological Month Mean' (recommended): fills gaps with the average of the same calendar month across years, with station mean fallback. 'Linear + Boundary Interpolation': fills interior gaps linearly and endpoints using boundary fill. 'Spatial Nearest Neighbor Fallback': estimates missing fields from nearest valid spatial stations. 'No Fill': ignores missing values.

parameters.name: Point_Tolerance
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default 0 = OFF). Merges points closer than this distance before download to reduce interpolation artifacts.

parameters.name: Climate_Modules
choices: Heat Index / Thermal Stress [Requires: Temperature, Relative Humidity]
Wind Chill / Cold Stress [Requires: Temperature, Wind]
De Martonne Aridity Index [Requires: Temperature, Precipitation]
Walter-Lieth Dry Months Count [Requires: Temperature, Precipitation]
parameters.description: Select primary climate modules and applied bioclimatic models to compute and export. Submodels (De Martonne, Evapotranspiration, UNEP, Water Deficit, Walter-Lieth, Heat Index) are located at the bottom of the list and can be selected directly; prerequisite variables are retrieved automatically if not selected.

parameters.name: Temporal_Scope
parameters.description: TEMPORAL MATRIX SCOPE. Select which temporal scopes and seasons to compute and map (Annual, Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). Uncheck any seasons not needed (e.g. keep only Annual for fast regional atlas, or Summer only for heat waves). The tool computes only the Cartesian product of selected Climate Modules and selected Temporal Scope.

parameters.name: Generate_Monthly_Rasters
parameters.description: GENERATE 12 INDIVIDUAL MONTHLY RASTERS (Jan-Dec). When checked, interpolates independent climatological surface rasters for all 12 calendar months into a dedicated 'Month' subfolder for each selected element (same interpolation method, cell size and clip mask; LZW, 128x128 blocks). Requires a multi-year period (>= 2 years); single years are skipped with a warning. Wind produces 24 surfaces (12 speed W_Spd_* + 12 direction W_Dir_*).

parameters.name: Save_Daily_Series
parameters.en: Save Daily Time Series (Excel Sheets + GDB Table)
parameters.ar: حفظ السلاسل الزمنية اليومية (شيتات Excel + قاعدة البيانات)
parameters.description: When enabled (with Daily temporal resolution), saves the complete daily time series into Daily sheets in Excel and a table inside the Geodatabase. Large daily series use additional Excel sheets; CSV is used only if Excel export fails.

parameters.name: Extended_WC_Seasons
parameters.en: Wind Chill Full Suite for Cold Regions (Seasons+Ranges+Monthly)
parameters.ar: Wind Chill Full Suite for Cold Regions (Seasons+Ranges+Monthly)
parameters.description: OPT-IN FOR COLD REGIONS ONLY (e.g. Patagonia, Iceland, high mountains, Canada): publishes WC_Spring/Summer/Autumn_Mean, WC_Annual_Range and the 12 monthly WC means in addition to WC_Winter_Mean and WC_Annual_Mean. OFF by default: warm regions (e.g. Egypt) keep the clean 2-field schema, where extra fields would merely repeat air temperature (passthrough). Same NWS equation/threshold.

parameters.name: Monthly_Ranges
parameters.en: Monthly Ranges - Interannual Variability per Month
parameters.ar: Monthly Ranges - Interannual Variability per Month
parameters.description: OPT-IN, independent toggle (default OFF): adds per-calendar-month interannual ranges (<Prefix>_<Month>_Range, e.g. ET_December_Range = wettest December minus driest December across years) for the mean-type modules (T, R, PSL, PS, Wind speed, RH, Td, Solar, UV, Cloud, ET). Wind direction excluded. Month sheet and Month/ rasters carry them like the monthly means. Needs >= 2 valid years per month; gap-filled months yield 0.

parameters.name: Extended_HI_Months
parameters.description: OPT-IN, independent toggle (default OFF): publishes the 12 monthly Rothfusz heat-index means (HI_January_Mean ... HI_December_Mean) in addition to the 8 base Heat Index fields. Documented winter caveat: monthly values use Rothfusz year-round (= air T below 26.7C), while the seasonal HI_Winter_Mean uses Humidex. Month sheet and Month/ rasters carry them like the other monthly means.

parameters.name: Field_Filter_Scope
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Controls which variables, seasons, and indicators are computed and exported. 'Full Suite (Annual + Seasonal + Monthly)' (default): calculates and maps all annual, seasonal, monthly and extreme fields. 'Annual Summaries Only': restricts processing strictly to annual summaries, means and totals. 'Seasonal Summaries Only': restricts processing strictly to seasonal summaries (Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). 'Monthly Climatology Only (Jan - Dec)': restricts processing strictly to the 12 individual calendar months (Jan-Dec). 'Filter by Specific Seasons & Aggregations': quickly filter by specific season or summary level. 'Custom Field Checklist': interactive checklist table at the end of this group to select/unselect exact fields by name.

parameters.name: Included_Aggregations
parameters.description: PERIOD FILTER ONLY. Choose summary levels to generate. 'Annual Summaries': annual means and totals. 'Seasonal Summaries': seasonal means and totals (Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn). 'Detailed Monthly Climatology': 12 individual monthly climatologies (Jan-Dec). 'Extreme & Bioclimatic Indices': heat index, ranges, extreme months, rain days.

parameters.name: Included_Seasons
parameters.description: SEASONS FILTER ONLY. Select which seasons to generate. Uncheck any season you do not need (e.g. keep only Summer or only Winter).

parameters.name: Selected_Fields
parameters.description: VARIABLES SELECTION. Interactive checklist of climate variables and indicators to compute. All fields for the selected Climate Modules are included by default. Check or uncheck individual variables as needed, or use the Filter Scope above to filter by seasons/periods.

parameters.name: Interpolation_Method
parameters.description: REQUIRED. IDW (default) | Ordinary Kriging | Spline | Natural Neighbor. Requires Spatial Analyst.

parameters.name: Base_Cell_Size
parameters.description: REQUIRED. Cell size for all rasters in Meters or Kilometers. Default: 500 Meters. NOTE: fine cells improve appearance only; native NASA POWER resolution stays coarse (~0.5 deg).

parameters.name: Wind_Factor_Cell_Size
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Independent coarser spacing for wind arrow points in Meters or Kilometers. Default: 25000 Meters. Enabled only when Wind module is selected.

parameters.name: IDW_Curve_Profile
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Distance decay curve profile. 'Gentle / Smooth' (power 1.2) eliminates concentric island/bullseye artifacts. 'Standard' (power 2.0) is the classical steep quadratic decay. 'Regional Broad' (power 0.7) gives extended regional smoothing. 'Custom Power' allows typing an arbitrary power.

parameters.name: IDW_Power
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Power parameter. DEFAULT 1.2 for smooth, seamless climate surfaces without artificial bullseyes.

parameters.name: IDW_Search_Type
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. 'Variable' (default): expand search. 'Fixed': fixed radius.

parameters.name: IDW_Num_Points
parameters.description: IDW ONLY. Number of neighbouring points. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: IDW_Max_Distance
parameters.description: IDW ONLY, OPTIONAL. Caps the search neighbourhood in metres.

parameters.name: Krig_Model
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. DEFAULT Spherical.

parameters.name: Krig_Type
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. 'Ordinary' (default) or 'Universal'.

parameters.name: Krig_Num_Points
parameters.description: KRIGING ONLY. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: Spline_Type
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. 'Tension' (recommended for climate): produces taut, smooth surfaces that honor exact point values without overshoots. 'Regularized': smooth surface that may overshoot local extremes.

parameters.name: Spline_Weight
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. Weight parameter. For Tension Spline, higher weights (e.g. 5.0-10.0) produce stiffer, less smoothed surfaces closely matching points; smaller weights produce smoother surfaces. DEFAULT 5.0.

parameters.name: Spline_Num_Points
parameters.description: SPLINE ONLY. Number of neighbouring points used for interpolation. DEFAULT 12.

parameters.name: Enable_Raster_Reclass
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). When checked, generates classified rasters (_cls.tif) with discrete thematic classes and embedded colormaps alongside the continuous rasters. When unchecked, outputs only raw continuous floating-point rasters.

parameters.name: Reclass_Classes_Count
parameters.description: RECLASS ONLY. Number of classification bins/classes (2 to 32). Default: 7.

parameters.name: Reclass_Method
parameters.description: RECLASS ONLY. Statistical classification method to partition raster continuous values.

parameters.name: Create_Isobars
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Creates isobar polylines from pressure rasters when a pressure module is selected.

parameters.name: Pressure_Interval_Scheme
parameters.description: ISOBARS ONLY. Contour interval preset.

parameters.name: Custom_Pressure_Step
parameters.description: ISOBARS ONLY, CUSTOM SCHEME ONLY. Step in mbar/hPa. Must be > 0.

parameters.name: Focal_Smoothing
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. Smooths interpolated rasters with Focal Statistics.

parameters.name: Focal_Statistic
parameters.description: FOCAL ONLY. DEFAULT MEAN.

parameters.name: Focal_Neighborhood
parameters.description: FOCAL ONLY. Square neighbourhood in cells (3 = 3x3). DEFAULT 3.

parameters.name: Add_To_Map
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default OFF). Safely adds final layers to the current map sequentially.

parameters.name: Map_Add_Modules
parameters.description: ADD-TO-MAP ONLY. Choose which elements to add to the map.

parameters.name: Purge_Cache
parameters.description: OPTIONAL (default ON). Deletes intermediate products after use.

parameters.name: Export_Separate_Years
parameters.en: Export Separate Excel Workbook per Year (also keep combined workbook)
parameters.ar: تصدير ملف Excel مستقل لكل سنة (بالإضافة إلى الملف المجمع)
parameters.description: For multi-year downloads, also export <Element>/Years/<Element>_<Year>.xls. Recomputes each year's Data and Month summaries from that year's data using the same units and gap filling; includes Source_Data and Daily sheets when daily saving is enabled. Reuses downloaded data. Does not create separate yearly rasters or GIS databases.

Interpolate & Map Existing Data (Offline Mode - No Internet)

parameters.name: Execution_Workflow_Mode
parameters.default: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
choices: Batch Mode: Download All Then Process [Recommended]
parameters.description:
DOWNLOAD MODE ONLY. Choose workflow execution architecture:
'Batch Mode: Download All Then Process' (recommended): Downloads gridded data and builds master point layers in the Geodatabase for all requested modules first, ensuring data integrity against network interruptions, then interpolates all surfaces in a second pass.
'Sequential Mode: Element by Element': Downloads, builds points, and interpolates surfaces for each module one by one, providing immediate visual progress in the map layout.

parameters.name: Precalculated_Point_Layers

parameters.name: Download_Extent_Layer
